messages:
maria: CI microbench failing on PR#18888 — kv-prefetch end-to-end latency up ~12% on batcher path. perf-unit threshold diff +0.12ms mean.
perf-bot: perf/regress detected: microbench_kv_prefetch mean +12.1% (p<0.01). baseline: 0.98ms -> current: 1.10ms
joel: ugh. PR touches queue allocator and batch scheduling. suspect batcher wait/timer change.
maria: repro locally? steps:
```
make test-bench && ./bench --test microbench_kv_prefetch --runs 50
```
joel: repro ok on my linux box, 'perf record' shows hot path in kernel_selector::score_candidates
rachel: attaching flamegraph link: https://perf.internal/fg/6501234567
rachel: flame shows extra cost in `select_kernel_for_batch` after the allocator change
aisling: can someone run bisect across commits in PR? maybe revert to pre-allocator commit
ben: I ran a quick bisect: reverting commit 7a2f5d removes regression (back to 0.99ms)
joel: commit 7a2f5d is the allocator pool bump + small scheduler tweak. Could affect batch alignment -> kernel scoring picks slower kernel due to different seq_len distribution
maria: action items: 1) reproduce across GPU types (A100, H100) 2) bisect to isolate lines 3) add unit test for batcher timing invariants 4) revert if can't fix fast
ben: I pushed a tmp revert branch: revert/18888-allocator-hotpath
ci-bot: revert branch built: `build/6501234601` - passing smoke + unit, running microbench
joel: quick profiler (perf top) snippet: 
```
#  percentage  function
  23.4%      select_kernel_for_batch
  15.7%      compute_kernel_score
  12.8%      kv_cache_lookup
```
maria: also saw kv cache hitrate drop ~3% in shadow runs — could be batch alignment causing different kv key chunking
aisling: ok I'll run experiments toggling allocator pool size and batch timer to see sensitivity
maria: if we don't have a patch by EOD let's revert the merge to avoid rollout blocker
joel: Agree. ping me if you want help with the revert or patch.
rachel: logging note: add metric `batcher.kernel_choice_reason` (enum) so we see why kernel was chosen
maria: thanks all, will update thread with bisect result
ci-bot: microbench results: baseline 0.980ms current 1.098ms diff +12.1% (threshold 8%)
ben: bisect points to line change in scheduler.cpp: `if (batch_wait_ns > ... )` -> I'll open a tiny PR with alternative heuristic
maria: awesome. :thumbsup:
